query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE agents SET project_id = $2, workflow_id = $3, workflow_run_id = $4, deleted = TRUE WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO agent_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($5, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $6, unnested.event_type, unnested.event FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($7::TEXT[], $8::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event) RETURNING recorded_at
